title: 30 By ANT
description: This dataset comprises neuroimaging recordings from 30 participants who received laser stimulation at individually calibrated pain thresholds and provided verbal pain ratings. Participants underwent a series of laser stimuli while maintaining visual fixation, with pain intensity ratings collected on a 0-10 scale. The dataset is designed to investigate the neural correlates of pain perception and subjective pain rating processes.
methods_description: Participants received laser stimulation at intensities calibrated to produce an average pain rating of 7. Each participant underwent 30 laser stimuli trials with a 5-second inter-stimulus interval. After each stimulation, participants verbally rated pain intensity on a scale from 0 (no sensation) to 10 (unbearable pain). Participants were instructed to maintain visual fixation on a crosshair during stimulation. Laser markers in the dataset are delayed by 100ms.
